==Description==
The '''Present''' was the third enemy that appeared on [[Krampus Frosthold]] in the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had higher health than all enemies that appeared before it, though it was slower than the [[Speedy Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Speedy Elf]]. It also had a low defense.

The '''Present''' could also be spawned by the [[Present2 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present2]]. Unlike its parent enemies, it did not spawn anything upon death.

==Appearance==
The '''Present''' was a humanoid present. The wrapping paper was a pattern of red stars against a blue background. A white ribbon was wrapped across its head and torso, and was tied together with a big red bow on its chest. 

==Strategy==
*As the '''Present''' spawns in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Golden Pyromancer]] or [[Mortar]] are very useful against it.
**On later waves, it can easily be killed by high DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Minigunner]] can clear these out easily.
